sufficient_sets.text: Johannes Gutenberg invented the movable-type printing press around 1440, utilizing four existing technologies: the screw press, movable type, the codex book format, and mechanized paper production.
A printing press is a machine that applies pressure to transfer ink onto a surface made of paper, cloth, or a similar material.

labels.answer_text: paper, cloth, or a similar material
